verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5070 family page says users can maximize performance across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch and other inference backends. The CUDA Toolkit page documents GPU-accelerated AI and data-science libraries and NGC containers, so mainstream framework support on this GPU is officially claimed. Missing for 10: an official support matrix listing the RTX 5070 Ti/Blackwell for PyTorch and other frameworks, documented framework builds and versions for this GPU, training (not just inference) coverage, and independent or hands-on confirmation that PyTorch runs on the card.
